newsitem.title: CANADA: Royal Bank of Canada raises dividends.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank of Canada raises dividends.

text.p: Royal Bank of Canada said on Tuesday that it raised its quarterly dividend to C$0.39 a share from C$0.37, payable on August 22 to shareholders of record on July 24.

Canada's largest bank also said that its board approved a rise of 0.25 percent in the dividend rate for its C$1.5 million worth of first preferred shares series E and changed the dividend to non-cumulative from cumulative. Royal said its preferred shares may not be redeemed by the bank for a period of five years to September 1, 2002.

A special meeting of holders of series E preferred shares was called for for August 15 to approve the amendments. The amendments must be approved by 66-2/3 percent of the votes cast at the special meeting. If approved, the amended dividend rate would first apply to the payment date of October 10, 1997 for shareholders of record on September 30, 1997.
